splitPolicy: Both selected source groups are new holdout scenes. They were acquired and manually annotated without viewing target-model or automatic-region outputs. No label, radius, count or ignored border may be changed based on subsequent predictions. Prior v1/v2 data remain unchanged.
annotationPolicy: Full original upright photos are input. Review crops are annotation aids only and are not inference regions. Mark visible terminal faces. Ignore uncertain center-out-of-frame fragments; partial images do not contribute to whole-image exact count or MAE.
algorithmCheckpointStatus: PENDING_ROOT_FINALIZATION; acquisition/annotation agent has not run inference
limitations: Two online product photographs, not a representative restaurant field trial.
Vietnam has37 confident visible end faces plus an ignored bottom-left out-of-frame fragment; not eligible for a complete count.
Allegro has103 verified visible square terminal faces; square shape is explicitly a robustness stress case separate from common round skewers.
No training corpus is available, so unknown overlap with original model training photos cannot be excluded.
Retail package quantities were not accepted as labels. Perceptual hashes and visual review screen duplicates but do not establish statistical independence.
All downloaded originals and diagnostic overlays remain local under gitignored output/web-annotation-v3. No fabricated or generated test imagery.
